name: acceler-presales
description: Acceler Atlas — turns discovery, precedent-matching, proposal writing, deck generation, pricing and instructor staffing into slash commands, powered by the Acceler Knowledge Graph (61 clients · 1,072 files · 773 instructors). 7 skills, one SKILL.md each — discovery-checklist, doc-proposal, mini-ut-context, pricing, proposal-deck, pptx-deck, requirement-mapping — plus 9 commands covering the pre-sales pipeline (discovery, similar, proposal, proposal-deck, pricing, instructors, coverage) plus setup and full-cycle orchestration. Delivery/post-sales artifacts (session deck, session recap, pick-your-use-case build lab) live in the companion acceler-post-sales plugin in this same repo.
